method: Target lookup compares class ID, reads one-byte record count at +1, advances by two bytes and scans four-byte ID/offset records. Count 198 reaches the final record and its pointer immediately follows ID 1927 data.
limitations: Purpose and mutability of 52-byte payload unknown.

overlap_investigation.interpretation: The lookup interprets the following first byte as message length, but target index may refer to the next data structure or a sentinel. No allocation boundary or runtime ownership established; absence of common immediate forms is not proof that 9900 is unused.
